recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed unless a future CDS decision intentionally changes the Person boundary rule or explicitly allows Person as a RequestOrchestration action participant.
issue_request: FHIR-15592 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for STU3 asking to remove Person from RequestGroup.action.participant because Person is not meant to be directly referenced as an actor or acted upon by clinical or administrative resources.
initial_application: The issue was originally applied in SVN 13285, mirrored as git commit 222fded13d4e46e979f9c58d9399ecd625974a30, which removed Person from source/requestgroup/requestgroup-spreadsheet.xml's RequestGroup.action.participant reference target list.
additional_context: RequestGroup has since been renamed to RequestOrchestration. source/fhir.ini actively builds requestorchestration=RequestOrchestration and maps RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration for migration. Later RequestGroup/RequestOrchestration changes, including FHIR-24618, FHIR-24619, and FHIR-39267, changed the source shape and naming but did not reintroduce Person as an action participant target.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current RequestOrchestration.action.participant.typeReference and actor[x] Reference target profiles list participant-pattern resources such as Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and RelatedPerson, but not Person.

related_jiras.note: Remodeled RequestGroup.action.participant to support definitional participants without adding Person as a participant target.
Renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration, explaining the current source location and fhir.ini migration mapping.
Aligned RequestOrchestration.subject with participant-pattern resources and likewise did not include Person.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final approved requirement to exclude Person from the participant reference target list.

evidence_items.summary: SVN 13285 git mirror commit removed Person from source/requestgroup/requestgroup-spreadsheet.xml.
evidence_items.learned: The historical application implemented the requested removal before the current reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: fhir.ini actively builds RequestOrchestration and maps the old RequestGroup name to RequestOrchestration.
evidence_items.learned: RequestOrchestration is the build-scoped current source to inspect for this old RequestGroup issue.

evidence_items.summary: Current participant.typeReference and participant.actor[x] Reference target profiles list participant-pattern resources but not Person.
evidence_items.learned: The current authoritative RequestOrchestration definition remains consistent with FHIR-15592.

evidence_items.summary: Person narrative says Person instances are never directly referenced as actors, authors, subjects, performers, or similar resources.
evidence_items.learned: The boundary rationale behind removing Person from RequestGroup remains present in the current source.

evidence_items.summary: Later published RequestGroup/RequestOrchestration issues remodeled participants, renamed the resource, and aligned subject types.
evidence_items.learned: These later changes explain the current source shape and do not supersede the exclusion of Person as an action participant.
